camel_example: aliyun dbs ConfigureBackupPlan --region cn-hangzhou --BackupPlanName dbstooi00000000 --BackupPlanId dbstooi00000000 --SourceEndpointInstanceType RDS
description_en: Configures a Database Backup (DBS) backup plan
description_zh: 该接口用于配置一个DBS备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun dbs configure-backup-plan --backup-plan-id dbstooi00000000 --source-endpoint-instance-type RDS --backup-plan-name dbstooi00000000 --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigureBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query the backup plan ID
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The location of the database. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value. Valid values:

RDS

ECS

Express: A database connected through a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Gateway.

Agent: A database connected through a backup gateway.

DDS: Cloud MongoDB.

Other: A database directly connected through IP:Port
parameters.help_zh:
数据库所在位置，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。取值如下：

RDS
ECS
Express：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
Agent：通过备份网关接入的数据库
DDS：云MongoDB
Other：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region of the database. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpointInstanceType is RDS, ECS, DDS, Express, or Agent
parameters.help_zh:
数据库地域，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is RDS, ECS, DDS, or Express
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database endpoint. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpointInstanceType is express, agent, or other
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接地址，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为express、agent、other时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The database port. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is express, agent, other, or ECS
parameters.help_zh:
数据库端口，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为express、agent、other、ECS时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The database name. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

This parameter is required when the database type is PostgreSQL or MongoDB
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

数据库类型为PostgreSQL、MongoDB时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_database_name

parameters.help_en:
The database account.

This parameter is optional when the database type is Redis, or when the database location is agent and the database type is SQL Server. It is required in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为SQL Server时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password.

This parameter is optional when the database type is Redis, or when the database location is agent and the database type is SQL Server. It is required in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
密码。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为SQL Server时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
The backup gateway ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpointInstanceType is agent
parameters.help_zh:
备份网关ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: backup_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS bucket name.

The system automatically generates a new name by default
parameters.help_zh:
OSS Bucket名称。

系统默认自动生成新的名称
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.example: [     {         "DBName":"待备份库名",         "SchemaName":"待备份 Schema 名",         "TableIncludes":[{             "TableName":"待备份表表名"         }],         "TableExcludes":[{             "TableName":"待备份库名不需要备份表的表名"         }]     } ]
parameters.help_en: The backup objects. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value
parameters.help_zh: 备份对象，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_objects

parameters.help_en:
The full backup period. Valid values:

Monday: Monday

Tuesday: Tuesday

Wednesday: Wednesday

Thursday: Thursday

Friday: Friday

Saturday: Saturday

Sunday: Sunday
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日
parameters.name: backup_period

parameters.help_en: The full backup start time in HH:mmZ (UTC) format. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value
parameters.help_zh: 全量备份开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_start_time

parameters.help_en:
Enable incremental log backup. Valid values:

true: Enable

false: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启增量日志备份，取值：
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: enable_backup_log

parameters.help_en:
The incremental interval in seconds (s).

Only physical backup is supported
parameters.help_zh:
增量时间间隔，以秒（s）为单位。
仅支持物理备份
parameters.name: backup_log_interval_seconds

parameters.help_en: The retention period for backup data. Valid values: 0 to 1825. Default value: 730 days
parameters.help_zh: 备份数据保留时间，取值：0 ~ 1825，默认为730天
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en: The period after which data is converted to Infrequent Access storage. Default value: 180 days
parameters.help_zh: 转为低频访问存储时间，默认为180天
parameters.name: duplication_infrequent_access_period

parameters.help_en: The period after which data is converted to archive cold storage. Default value: 365 days
parameters.help_zh: 转为归档冷备存储时间，默认为365天
parameters.name: duplication_archive_period

parameters.help_en: The custom backup plan name. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html to query this value
parameters.help_zh: 自定义备份计划名称，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The Oracle SID name.

This parameter is required when the database type is Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
Oracle SID名称。

数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_oracle_sid

parameters.help_en:
The built-in storage type:

Empty (default): Backup data is stored on your OSS.

system: Backup data is stored on the built-in OSS of DBS
parameters.help_zh:
内置存储类型：
空（默认）：备份数据存储在用户OSS上。
system ：备份数据存储在DBS的内置OSS上
parameters.name: backup_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk I/O limit in KB/s.

This parameter is valid only for MySQL physical backup
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘IO限制 ， 单位为KB/s。
仅对MySQL物理备份生效
parameters.name: backup_speed_limit

parameters.help_en:
The network bandwidth throttling in KB/s. The maximum value is 10 GB.

This parameter is valid only for MySQL physical backup
parameters.help_zh:
网络带宽限制， 单位为KB/s ，最大允许10GB。
仅对MySQL物理备份生效
parameters.name: backup_rate_limit

parameters.help_en:
The full backup period. Valid values:

simple: Periodic backup. Use this value with BackupPeriod and BackupStartTime.

manual: Manual backup.

Default value: simple
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
simple：周期备份，和BackupPeriod、BackupStartTime配合使用。
manual：手动备份。

默认为simple
parameters.name: backup_strategy_type

parameters.help_en: The UID for cross-Alibaba Cloud account backup. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869838.html to query this value
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的UID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869838.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: cross_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The RAM role name for cross-Alibaba Cloud account backup. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869838.html to query this value
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869838.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: cross_role_name

parameters.help_en:
Enable automatic backup. Valid values:

true: Enable

false: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动备份。

true：开启
false：不开启
parameters.name: auto_start_backup

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value, which must be unique among different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: 是否开启备份源数据库实例SSL安全连接
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启备份源数据库实例SSL安全连接
parameters.name: enable_source_endpoint_ssl

parameters.help_en: 备份存储加密方式
parameters.help_zh: 备份存储加密方式
parameters.name: backup_storage_encrypt_method

parameters.help_en: 备份源数据库SSL安全连接PEM证书
parameters.help_zh: 备份源数据库SSL安全连接PEM证书
parameters.name: ssl_ca_pem

parameters.help_en: Oracle Home
parameters.help_zh: Oracle Home
parameters.name: source_endpoint_oracle_home

parameters.help_en: 开启MySQL物理备份的日志备份
parameters.help_zh: 开启MySQL物理备份的日志备份
parameters.name: enable_mysql_physical_backup_binlog
